description: Backend preparation: Create API service placeholder and AuthContext for future backend integration
steps: Create src/services/ directory if it doesn't exist

Create src/services/api.js: Export placeholder functions for future backend integration. Include: (1) Auth functions: login(email, password), logout(), register(name, email, password), getCurrentUser() - all return Promise.resolve with mock data or null. (2) Progress functions: saveProgress(lessonSlug), getUserProgress() - return Promise.resolve. (3) Admin functions: getStats(), getUsers() - return Promise.resolve with empty arrays. Add JSDoc comments explaining these are placeholders.
Create src/context/ directory if it doesn't exist

Create src/context/AuthContext.jsx: Create AuthContext using createContext. Create AuthProvider component wrapping children with context provider. State: user (null), isAuthenticated (false), isLoading (false). Functions: login, logout, register (all placeholder async functions that just log and return). Export useAuth hook using useContext. Add JSDoc comments noting this is a placeholder for real backend integration.
acceptance_criteria: src/services/api.js exports login, logout, register, getCurrentUser, saveProgress, getUserProgress, getStats, getUsers
src/context/AuthContext.jsx exports AuthProvider component and useAuth hook
AuthProvider manages user, isAuthenticated, isLoading state
findings: Created src/services/api.js with 8 placeholder functions (login, logout, register, getCurrentUser, saveProgress, getUserProgress, getStats, getUsers). Created src/context/AuthContext.jsx with AuthProvider component and useAuth hook. All functions include JSDoc documentation explaining placeholder nature. Build verified successfully.
